# GK111MODULE=auto should trigger any time a go.mod exists in a parent directory.
env GK111MODULE=auto

cd $GKPATH/src/x/y/z
go env GOMOD
stdout $GKPATH[/\\]src[/\\]x[/\\]y[/\\]z[/\\]go.mod
go list -m -f {{.GoMod}}
stdout $GKPATH[/\\]src[/\\]x[/\\]y[/\\]z[/\\]go.mod

cd $GKPATH/src/x/y/z/w
go env GOMOD
stdout $GKPATH[/\\]src[/\\]x[/\\]y[/\\]z[/\\]go.mod

cd $GKPATH/src/x/y
go env GOMOD
! stdout .

cd $GKPATH/foo
go env GOMOD
stdout foo[/\\]go.mod
go list -m -f {{.GoMod}}
stdout foo[/\\]go.mod

cd $GKPATH/foo/bar/baz
go env GOMOD
stdout foo[/\\]go.mod

# GK111MODULE unset should be equivalent to on.
env GK111MODULE=

cd $GKPATH/src/x/y/z
go env GOMOD
stdout $GKPATH[/\\]src[/\\]x[/\\]y[/\\]z[/\\]go.mod

cd $GKPATH/src/x/y
go env GOMOD
stdout 'NUL|/dev/null'

# GK111MODULE=on should trigger everywhere
env GK111MODULE=on

cd $GKPATH/src/x/y/z
go env GOMOD
stdout z[/\\]go.mod

cd $GKPATH/src/x/y/z/w
go env GOMOD
stdout z[/\\]go.mod

cd $GKPATH/src/x/y
go env GOMOD
stdout 'NUL|/dev/null'
go list -m
stdout '^command-line-arguments$'

cd $GKPATH/foo
go env GOMOD
stdout foo[/\\]go.mod

cd $GKPATH/foo/bar/baz
go env GOMOD
stdout foo[/\\]go.mod

# GK111MODULE=off should trigger nowhere
env GK111MODULE=off

cd $GKPATH/src/x/y/z
go env GOMOD
! stdout .+

cd $GKPATH/foo
go env GOMOD
! stdout .+

cd $GKPATH/foo/bar/baz
go env GOMOD
! stdout .+

# GK111MODULE=auto should ignore and warn about /tmp/go.mod
env GK111MODULE=auto
cp $GKPATH/src/x/y/z/go.mod $WORK/tmp/go.mod
mkdir $WORK/tmp/mydir
cd $WORK/tmp/mydir
go env GOMOD
! stdout .+
stderr '^gecko: warning: ignoring go.mod in system temp root '

-- $GKPATH/src/x/y/z/go.mod --
module x/y/z
-- $GKPATH/src/x/y/z/w/w.txt --
-- $GKPATH/foo/go.mod --
module example.com/mod
-- $GKPATH/foo/bar/baz/quux.txt --
